stockTransfers.title: Stock transfers · two people at each end
stockTransfers.subtitle: Between the factory, office and shops · goods are in transit until someone else counts them in, so nothing goes missing between places
stockTransfers.readOnly: Read-only access: you can follow transfers but not act on them.
stockTransfers.emptyBody: A shop, the office or the factory asks for stock with “New transfer”; another person approves it.
stockTransfers.sameBranchNote: Same branch, same GSTIN: a delivery challan is made when the goods leave.
stockTransfers.gstNote: Same GSTIN: a delivery challan is made at dispatch. Another GSTIN: a posted tax invoice with IGST to that GSTIN is needed before the goods leave.

err.from: Choose where the stock comes from.
err.line: Line {{n}}: choose the item and enter a quantity above zero.

detail.missing: That transfer was not found in this company.
detail.title: {{no}} · {{from}} → {{to}}
detail.challanMade: Delivery challan {{no}}, same GSTIN: goods are not sold.
detail.challanAtDispatch: Same GSTIN: a delivery challan is made when the carrier takes the goods.
detail.invoiceNeeded: Another GSTIN ({{gstin}}): the goods leave only with a posted tax invoice with IGST to that GSTIN.

balance.title: Balance rule
balance.inTransit: Still in transit, owner: the carrier
balance.rule: Dispatched = accepted + quarantined + returned + approved loss + still in transit. The transfer stays open until the last unit is found, returned or written off by someone other than the picker, the carrier or the receiver.
balance.blind: Blind count: what was sent is hidden from the receiving side until the goods are counted in.

act.title: Next step · {{state}}
act.noRight: You don't have the right for this step. Ask Admin.
act.noCloseRight: Closing needs the close right (factory manager or finance).
act.approveNote: Another person approves: never the one who asked. Change a quantity if less can be sent.
act.reserveNote: The factory custodian reserves released stock for the approved quantities, so nobody else can use it meanwhile.
act.pickNote: The picker picks only approved quantities of released lots, earliest expiry first.
act.noLots: No lot numbers (counted in one figure)
act.pickerNote: The picker confirms the handover on their own login.
act.carrierNoteChallan: The carrier takes over on their own login, never the picker's. The stock leaves this place and sits in transit; the delivery challan is made now.
act.carrierNoteInvoice: The carrier takes over on their own login. Link the posted tax invoice to {{gstin}} with IGST; without it the goods cannot leave.
act.noInvoices: No posted tax invoices from this GSTIN
act.receiveNote: Count what arrived without the expected quantity. Good goes into stock, damaged into QC hold; anything not counted stays in transit. The picker can never receive.
act.witnessHelp: Needed only when the carrier also receives: a second person on their own login.
act.witnessNone: If you carried these goods, a second authorised person must receive them, or Admin records the receipt with a witness.
act.received: Transfer {{no}} counted in. Still in transit: {{left}}.
act.reconcileNote: Settle what is still in transit: goods found later go into stock or QC hold, goods sent back go into QC hold at the sender. A shortage is written off only with the finance right, never by the picker, the carrier or the receiver.
act.reconcileReason: Note or reason for the write-off
act.closeNote: Close when nothing is in transit. Never by the picker or the carrier.
act.cancelledNote: This transfer was cancelled before the goods left.

picker.title: Picker
picker.body: Picks only approved quantities of released stock, lot by lot; sees no prices.

custodian.title: Factory custodian
custodian.body: Checks the request against released stock and expiry and reserves it.

handover.title: Handover
handover.body: Picker and carrier each confirm on their own login; shared logins are not allowed.

receiver.title: Receiver
receiver.body: Counts with the expected quantity hidden, then records good and damaged by lot.

same.title: Same person carrying and receiving
same.body: A second authorised person must witness the receipt; one login can never close both ends.

writeOff.title: Shortage write-off
writeOff.body: Never by the picker, the carrier or the receiver; finance reviews it.

late.title: Late arrival
late.body: A transfer still in transit shows how many days it has been open.

difference.title: Open difference
difference.body: A transfer with goods still in transit cannot be closed.

extra.title: Extra goods received
extra.body: Not added at the receiver; the sending place checks and makes an extra dispatch.

same.title: Same GSTIN
same.body: Delivery challan, not a tax invoice.

other.title: Another GSTIN
other.body: Tax invoice with IGST to the receiving GSTIN, and an e-way bill where the value calls for one.

sellable.title: Sellable stock
sellable.body: Company stock includes transit; sellable stock leaves out transit, QC hold and holds.
